title: Irrigation audit and repair for a View Royal townhouse strata

seo.title: Sample project: View Royal irrigation audit | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: an irrigation audit and repair for a View Royal townhouse strata, with zone maps and controllers set to CRD watering days. Get a free quote.

summary: A zone-by-zone check and repair of an older strata irrigation system.
scope: Controller reset to CRD lawn days for the complex address
story: Some lawns were soggy while others browned, and nobody had a zone map.
We ran every zone, replaced broken heads and a sticking valve, and set the controller to the lawn days for the complex's street address. Council received a simple zone map.
Read more about [irrigation](/services/irrigation/), see our work in [View Royal](/areas/view-royal/), or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
result: Even coverage and a zone map the strata can hand to any contractor.
